meta.title: TuneTactics — Show your sound. Find your people.
meta.description: A community for producers and singers to showcase their work and find collaborators.

hero.headline: Show your sound. Find your people.
hero.subheadline: A community for producers and singers to showcase their work and find collaborators.
hero.trust: Founding members get Pro free for life.

problem.heading: Finding the right collaborator is broken.
problem.body: Social profiles don't show skill. DMs get buried. There's no place built for musicians to showcase work and actually connect.

how.heading: How it works
steps: Build a profile that shows your actual work — beats, vocals, reels.
Discover producers and singers by role, genre, and what they're looking for.

profiles.title: Portfolio profiles
profiles.body: Show your real work — embedded tracks, reels, skills, gear, and what you're looking for.

discovery.title: Discovery that works
discovery.body: Filter by role, genre, location, and collab intent. No more scrolling aimlessly.

reels.title: Reels for musicians
reels.body: Post short clips — a beat, a vocal run, a WIP. Get replies from people who want to build on it.

connect.title: Connect and message
connect.body: Skip the DMs that get buried. Reach the right people and start working.

form.heading: Be a founding member.
form.body: Join before launch and get Pro for life.
form.success: You're in. We'll email you when we launch.

items.a: Yes. Core features are free forever. Pro adds optional power tools.
We're targeting a private beta in the coming months. Waitlist members get in first.

items.q: Do I upload files or link to existing platforms?
items.a: At launch, you'll embed from SoundCloud, Spotify, YouTube, and Bandcamp. Native uploads come later.
Producers, singers, songwriters, and instrumentalists who want to collaborate — especially remotely.

items.q: How do you handle my data?
items.a: We store your email and your signup answers only. No spam, no resale.
